{{Quote|Intelligence agents are continually collecting information about these dangerous adversaries, and I will frequently be sending updates so all New Republic personnel are aware of these criminals.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="SWAJ1">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>}}
A document titled '''''Wanted by Cracken''''' was compiled by [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. It detailed individuals wanted for crimes against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Its first version was released around [[7 ABY]].<ref name="WCB SB" /> Cracken regularly updated the document as new threats were identified.<ref name="SWAJ1" />
